hero.slide1.title: Rest. Assured. All Classes of Insurance Under One Roof.
hero.slide1.desc: Oromia Insurance S.C. combines ETB 1 Billion in paid-up capital, ETB 3 Billion in subscribed capital, and 62 full-fledged branches protecting households, 1.6M+ farmers, and enterprises across Ethiopia.
hero.slide2.title: General (Non-Life) Motor, Fire, Marine & Engineering Protection
hero.slide2.desc: Accessible, dependable cover for vehicles, homes, condominiums, cargo transit, contractors, machinery, and surety bonds backed by prompt underwriting and speedy claims settlement.
hero.slide3.title: Life & Health Assurance — Protecting Tomorrow Together
hero.slide3.desc: Group & individual term life, endowment & annuity plans, education endowment, mortgage protection, medical insurance, and supplementary riders securing your loved ones.
hero.slide4.title: Agriculture & Microinsurance Empowering Farmers & Unions
hero.slide4.desc: Ethiopia's pioneer in Weather Index Crop, Multi-Peril Crop, Coffee Plantation, Livestock IBLI, and Credit Life — trusted by 34+ farmers' cooperative unions and 1.6M+ smallholder farmers.
hero.slide5.title: Halal Takaful — Sharia-Compliant Cooperative Protection
hero.slide5.desc: 100% Sharia-compliant Property, Motor, Engineering, Liability, Pecuniary, and Accident Takaful supervised by Oromia Insurance's independent Sharia Advisory Committee across all 62 branches.
